svg.title: When a file of a user stands for a document
svg.desc: Paperless Sync gives each user the documents that they own in Paperless. jamie can open a file with [P412] in its name. A file of the archive account stands for document 412, as before. A file of another user, sam, stands for it only when Paperless Sync gives sam the owner of document 412 in Paperless, by its table, the same ID or its group; otherwise sam could have renamed the file after a document of someone else, and it stands for no document. A file of another account stands for 412 only when jamie may only read it.
